EC1: Psychotic depression [AND] by DSM-IV, i.e., presence of delusions with a SCID-R score higher than 2;
EC2: High suicide risk, i.e. intent [OR] or plan to attempt suicide in near future;
EC3: Presence of any Axis I psychiatric disorder ([NOT] other than unipolar major depression) [OR] or substance abuse;
EC4: History of psychiatric disorders [NOT] other than unipolar major depression [OR] or generalized anxiety disorder (bipolar disorder [OR], hypomania [OR], and dysthymia are exclusion criteria);
EC5: Dementia: Diagnosis of dementia by DSM-IV;
EC7: Acute [OR] or severe medical illness [OR], i.e., delirium [OR], metastatic cancer [OR], decompensated cardiac [OR], liver [OR] or kidney failure [OR], major surgery [OR], stroke [OR] or myocardial infarction during the three months prior to entry; or use of drugs [AND] known to cause depression, e.g., reserpine [OR], alpha-methyl-dopa [OR], steroids [OR], sympathomimetics withdrawal;
EC8: Neurological brain disease [OR] and/or history of electroconvulsive therapy;
EC9: History of any use of citalopram [OR] or escitalopram [AND] during the current episode or need for drugs [AND] that may interact with these agents, i.e. drug metabolized by the 2D6 P450 isoenzyme system;
